attributes.$control__review: We used Makro to finally understand our cash position without spreadsheets. Forecasts that used to take hours now update automatically, and the insights helped us delay a hire and extend runway by months.
attributes.$control__useCases: Cashflow forecasting, expense control, runway planning

attributes.$control__review: We replaced our manual cash tracking with Makro in the first week. What used to live across multiple spreadsheets is now one clear source of truth. It changed how confident we feel making hiring and pricing decisions.
attributes.$control__useCases: Cashflow visibility, budget planning, decision support

attributes.$control__review: Makro helped us spot cash gaps early and act before they became a problem. The forecasting alone paid for itself — we avoided a costly mistake and aligned spending with real runway instead of guesses.
attributes.$control__useCases: Cashflow forecasting, risk prevention, runway monitoring

attributes.$control__review: Before Makro, we were flying blind between invoices and expenses. Now we see exactly how long our runway is and what each decision does to it. It’s become part of our weekly leadership routine.
attributes.$control__useCases: Expense control, runway planning, financial clarity
